title.narrative: Strengthening the leadership of the Indonesian National Commission on Violence against Women (Komnas Perempuan) to implement the Law on Sexual Violence Crimes and other relevant laws addressing gender based violence against women

description.narrative: The action aims to advancing Komnas Perempuan¿s capacity in promoting understanding of and commitment of key-actors at national an local level to implement the Law on Sexual Violence Crimes in compliance to the CAT Obligation, including relation to the work of National Mechanism for Prevention of Torture (NPM/KUPP)
